meaning_en: to fit the pack-saddle frame onto the camel

past.de: Der Hirt passte seiner Kamelstute den Sattel behutsam an
past.en: The herder fitted the saddle tree gently onto his camel

present.de: Er sattelt das Kamel mit einem gut gepolsterten Baum
present.en: He fits the camel with a softly padded saddle frame

imperative.de: Sattle ohne den Widerrist zu drücken!
imperative.en: Fit the saddle without pressing on the withers!
